hero.title: Fáilte go Scoil Bhríde
hero.lead: Scoil lán-Ghaeilge le foireann líofa, seomraí ranga comhbhácha, agus pobal gníomhach in aice le cathair na Gaillimhe.

ourSchool.headline: Ár Scoil
ourSchool.subheadline: Tá Scoil Bhríde suite i Mionloch, i bParóiste an Chaisleáin Gearr, díreach lasmuigh den chathair.
body: Tá ocht rang phríomhshrutha agus dhá rang speisialta againn. Tá clós spraoi bog den scoth againn do na páistí óga agus páirc astro nua-dhéanta in aice leis an scoil, a úsáidimid do gach cineál spóirt. Bíonn seisiúin spóirt againn le clubanna CLG agus rugbaí, agus úsáidimid an tÁras le haghaidh Corpoideachais agus imeachtaí scoile.

Is scoil sa Ghaeltacht muid agus tá Gaeilge líofa ag gach ball foirne. Múintear gach ábhar trí Ghaeilge sna Naíonáin, seachas Béarla ó Théarma 3 i Naíonáin Mhóra. Fágann sé seo cumas nádúrtha Gaeilge ag na daltaí don mheánscoil.

Is í ár scoil an t-aon scoil Ghaeilge le stádas Gaeltachta laistigh de theorainneacha na cathrach. Faigheann muid tacaíocht agus acmhainní breise. Le réimse leathan gníomhaíochtaí iarscoile agus ár naíonra féin, Bóín Dé, cuirimid pacáiste iomlán oideachais ar fáil do leanaí.
Má tá suim agat dul isteach i Scoil Bhríde, cuir glaoch orainn ar 091 323 626 agus eagraigh cruinniú lenár bPríomhoide, Máire De Brún.

about.heading: About
about.intro: Our aims and ethos as a Catholic primary school under the patronage of the Bishop of Galway.
about.aimsBody: The aim of Scoil Bhríde is to provide a caring, safe environment where each child can learn and achieve their highest potential. Irish is the first language of the school and families are encouraged to use Irish at home.
about.philosophyBody: Scoil Náisiúnta Bhríde is a Catholic primary school. We aim to give children a sound religious and moral education within the Catholic ethos of the school.
about.ethosBody: We nurture pride in the Irish language, culture, history and heritage of this Gaeltacht area and we foster respect, self-discipline, and responsibility.
homeParagraphs: Scoil Bhríde is located in Menlo, just outside Galway city. We are a Gaeltacht school and all staff are fluent in Irish. All subjects are taught through Irish from junior infants, with English starting in term 3 of senior infants.

We have a state-of-the-art soft play yard for junior pupils and an astro turf pitch used for all kinds of sport. We host training with Father Griffins Éire Óg, Caisleán Gearr CLG, and Corinthians Rugby, and we use the Áras for PE and school events.
If you are interested in Scoil Bhríde for your children, call us on (091) 762323 and our principal, Máire De Brún, will be happy to help.
naionraParagraphs: We are committed to providing an early care and education service of the highest standard and are registered with Tusla – The Child and Family Agency. Our trained, motivated, and friendly staff deliver a warm, stimulating, home-from-home environment.

We aim to provide a quality service and a stimulating environment where children develop social, personal, and educational skills through a planned curriculum. Your child’s welfare and your peace of mind are most important to us.
